title: The lame man healed at the Beautiful Gate + Peter's sermon in Solomon's Portico

paragraphs.text: Now Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, [being] the ninth [hour].
paragraphs.original: Πέτρος δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀνέβαινον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ὥραν τῆς προσευχῆς τὴν ἐνάτην,
paragraphs.translit: Petros de kai Iōannēs anebainon eis to hieron epi tēn hōran tēs proseuchēs tēn enatēn,

paragraphs.text: And a certain man that was lame from his mother`s womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
paragraphs.original: καί τις ἀνὴρ χωλὸς ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ ὑπάρχων ἐβαστάζετο, ὃν ἐτίθουν καθʼ ἡμέραν πρὸς τὴν θύραν τοῦ ἱεροῦ τὴν λεγομένην Ὡραίαν τοῦ αἰτεῖν ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ τῶν εἰσπορευομένων εἰς τὸ ἱερόν,
paragraphs.translit: kai tis anēr chōlos ek koilias mētros autou hyparchōn ebastazeto, hon etithoun kathʼ hēmeran pros tēn thyran tou hierou tēn legomenēn Hōraian tou aitein eleēmosynēn para tōn eisporeuomenōn eis to hieron,

paragraphs.text: who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, asked to receive an alms.
paragraphs.original: ὃς ἰδὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην μέλλοντας εἰσιέναι εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἠρώτα ἐλεημοσύνην λαβεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hos idōn Petron kai Iōannēn mellontas eisienai eis to hieron ērōta eleēmosynēn labein.

paragraphs.text: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him, with John, said, Look on us.
paragraphs.original: ἀτενίσας δὲ Πέτρος εἰς αὐτὸν σὺν τῷ Ἰωάννῃ εἶπεν· Βλέψον εἰς ἡμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: atenisas de Petros eis auton syn tō Iōannē eipen· Blepson eis hēmas.

paragraphs.text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something from them.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἐπεῖχεν αὐτοῖς προσδοκῶν τι παρʼ αὐτῶν λαβεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de epeichen autois prosdokōn ti parʼ autōn labein.

paragraphs.text: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but what I have, that give I thee. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν δὲ Πέτρος· Ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον οὐχ ὑπάρχει μοι, ὃ δὲ ἔχω τοῦτό σοι δίδωμι· ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου περιπάτει.
paragraphs.translit: eipen de Petros· Argyrion kai chrysion ouch hyparchei moi, ho de echō touto soi didōmi· en tō onomati Iēsou Christou tou Nazōraiou peripatei.

paragraphs.text: And he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πιάσας αὐτὸν τῆς δεξιᾶς χειρὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτόν· παραχρῆμα δὲ ἐστερεώθησαν αἱ βάσεις αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ σφυδρά,
paragraphs.translit: kai piasas auton tēs dexias cheiros ēgeiren auton· parachrēma de estereōthēsan hai baseis autou kai ta sphydra,

paragraphs.text: And leaping up, he stood, and began to walk; and he entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐξαλλόμενος ἔστη καὶ περιεπάτει, καὶ εἰσῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν περιπατῶν καὶ ἁλλόμενος καὶ αἰνῶν τὸν θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai exallomenos estē kai periepatei, kai eisēlthen syn autois eis to hieron peripatōn kai hallomenos kai ainōn ton theon.

paragraphs.text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶδεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτὸν περιπατοῦντα καὶ αἰνοῦντα τὸν θεόν,
paragraphs.translit: kai eiden pas ho laos auton peripatounta kai ainounta ton theon,

paragraphs.text: and they took knowledge of him, that it was he that sat for alms at the Beautiful Gate of the temple; and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
paragraphs.original: ἐπεγίνωσκον δὲ αὐτὸν ὅτι οὗτος ἦν ὁ πρὸς τὴν ἐλεημοσύνην καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῇ Ὡραίᾳ Πύλῃ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν θάμβους καὶ ἐκστάσεως ἐπὶ τῷ συμβεβηκότι αὐτῷ.
paragraphs.translit: epeginōskon de auton hoti houtos ēn ho pros tēn eleēmosynēn kathēmenos epi tē Hōraia Pylē tou hierou, kai eplēsthēsan thambous kai ekstaseōs epi tō symbebēkoti autō.

paragraphs.text: And as he held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon`s, greatly wondering.
paragraphs.original: Κρατοῦντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην συνέδραμεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῇ στοᾷ τῇ καλουμένῃ Σολομῶντος ἔκθαμβοι.
paragraphs.translit: Kratountos de autou ton Petron kai ton Iōannēn synedramen pas ho laos pros autous epi tē stoa tē kaloumenē Solomōntos ekthamboi.

paragraphs.text: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this man? or why fasten ye your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him to walk?
paragraphs.original: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπεκρίνατο πρὸς τὸν λαόν· Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται, τί θαυμάζετε ἐπὶ τούτῳ, ἢ ἡμῖν τί ἀτενίζετε ὡς ἰδίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ εὐσεβείᾳ πεποιηκόσιν τοῦ περιπατεῖν αὐτόν;
paragraphs.translit: idōn de ho Petros apekrinato pros ton laon· Andres Israēlitai, ti thaumazete epi toutō, ē hēmin ti atenizete hōs idia dynamei ē eusebeia pepoiēkosin tou peripatein auton;

paragraphs.text: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Servant Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied before the face of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.
paragraphs.original: ὁ θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακώβ, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν, ἐδόξασεν τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν, ὃν ὑμεῖς μὲν παρεδώκατε καὶ ἠρνήσασθε κατὰ πρόσωπον Πιλάτου, κρίναντος ἐκείνου ἀπολύειν·
paragraphs.translit: ho theos Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb, ho theos tōn paterōn hēmōn, edoxasen ton paida autou Iēsoun, hon hymeis men paredōkate kai ērnēsasthe kata prosōpon Pilatou, krinantos ekeinou apolyein·

paragraphs.text: But ye denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted unto you,
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ τὸν ἅγιον καὶ δίκαιον ἠρνήσασθε καὶ ᾐτήσασθε ἄνδρα φονέα χαρισθῆναι ὑμῖν,
paragraphs.translit: hymeis de ton hagion kai dikaion ērnēsasthe kai ētēsasthe andra phonea charisthēnai hymin,

paragraphs.text: and killed the Prince of life; whom God raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
paragraphs.original: τὸν δὲ ἀρχηγὸν τῆς ζωῆς ἀπεκτείνατε, ὃν ὁ θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν, οὗ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρές ἐσμεν.
paragraphs.translit: ton de archēgon tēs zōēs apekteinate, hon ho theos ēgeiren ek nekrōn, hou hēmeis martyres esmen.

paragraphs.text: And by faith in his name hath his name made this man strong, whom ye behold and know: yea, the faith which is through him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ τοῦτον ὃν θεωρεῖτε καὶ οἴδατε ἐστερέωσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ πίστις ἡ διʼ αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν ὁλοκληρίαν ταύτην ἀπέναντι πάντων ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai epi tē pistei tou onomatos autou touton hon theōreite kai oidate estereōsen to onoma autou, kai hē pistis hē diʼ autou edōken autō tēn holoklērian tautēn apenanti pantōn hymōn.

paragraphs.text: And now, brethren, I know that in ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ νῦν, ἀδελφοί, οἶδα ὅτι κατὰ ἄγνοιαν ἐπράξατε, ὥσπερ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Kai nyn, adelphoi, oida hoti kata agnoian epraxate, hōsper kai hoi archontes hymōn·

paragraphs.text: But the things which God foreshowed by the mouth of all the prophets, that his Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἃ προκατήγγειλεν διὰ στόματος πάντων τῶν προφητῶν παθεῖν τὸν χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπλήρωσεν οὕτως.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos ha prokatēngeilen dia stomatos pantōn tōn prophētōn pathein ton christon autou eplērōsen houtōs.

paragraphs.text: Repent ye therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, that so there may come seasons of refreshing from the presence of the Lord;
paragraphs.original: μετανοήσατε οὖν καὶ ἐπιστρέψατε πρὸς τὸ ἐξαλειφθῆναι ὑμῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας,
paragraphs.translit: metanoēsate oun kai epistrepsate pros to exaleiphthēnai hymōn tas hamartias,

paragraphs.text: and that he may send the Christ who hath been appointed for you, [even] Jesus:
paragraphs.original: ὅπως ἂν ἔλθωσιν καιροὶ ἀναψύξεως ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀποστείλῃ τὸν προκεχειρισμένον ὑμῖν χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν,
paragraphs.translit: hopōs an elthōsin kairoi anapsyxeōs apo prosōpou tou kyriou kai aposteilē ton prokecheirismenon hymin christon Iēsoun,

paragraphs.text: whom the heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, whereof God spake by the mouth of His holy prophets that have been from of old.
paragraphs.original: ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν μὲν δέξασθαι ἄχρι χρόνων ἀποκαταστάσεως πάντων ὧν ἐλάλησεν ὁ θεὸς διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπʼ αἰῶνος αὐτοῦ προφητῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hon dei ouranon men dexasthai achri chronōn apokatastaseōs pantōn hōn elalēsen ho theos dia stomatos tōn hagiōn apʼ aiōnos autou prophētōn.

paragraphs.text: Moses indeed said, A prophet shall the Lord God raise up unto you from among your brethren, like unto me. To him shall ye hearken in all things whatsoever he shall speak unto you.
paragraphs.original: Μωϋσῆς μὲν εἶπεν ὅτι Προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ· αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: Mōysēs men eipen hoti Prophētēn hymin anastēsei kyrios ho theos ek tōn adelphōn hymōn hōs eme· autou akousesthe kata panta hosa an lalēsē pros hymas.

paragraphs.text: And it shall be, that every soul that shall not hearken to that prophet, shall be utterly destroyed from among the people.
paragraphs.original: ἔσται δὲ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἥτις ἂν μὴ ἀκούσῃ τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: estai de pasa psychē hētis an mē akousē tou prophētou ekeinou exolethreuthēsetai ek tou laou.

paragraphs.text: Yea and all the prophets from Samuel and them that followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ προφῆται ἀπὸ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν καθεξῆς ὅσοι ἐλάλησαν καὶ κατήγγειλαν τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας.
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes de hoi prophētai apo Samouēl kai tōn kathexēs hosoi elalēsan kai katēngeilan tas hēmeras tautas.

paragraphs.text: Ye are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with your fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῆς διαθήκης ἧς διέθετο ὁ θεὸς πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν, λέγων πρὸς Ἀβραάμ· Καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου ἐνευλογηθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ τῆς γῆς.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis este hoi hyioi tōn prophētōn kai tēs diathēkēs hēs dietheto ho theos pros tous pateras hymōn, legōn pros Abraam· Kai en tō spermati sou eneulogēthēsontai pasai hai patriai tēs gēs.

paragraphs.text: Unto you first God, having raised up his Servant, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your iniquities.
paragraphs.original: ὑμῖν πρῶτον ἀναστήσας ὁ θεὸς τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εὐλογοῦντα ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέφειν ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῶν πονηριῶν ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hymin prōton anastēsas ho theos ton paida autou apesteilen auton eulogounta hymas en tō apostrephein hekaston apo tōn ponēriōn hymōn.
